extracted.name: Madakku pathiri(folded roti)
extracted.description: #goldenapron post19 This is also known as poo pathiri(flower pathiri) or kannu vecha pathiri.
ingredient_lines: as required oil for frying and applying
instruction_lines: Take a bowl and add both atta+maida and semolina it's optional for crispiness and add the ghee, egg, curd salt,sugar and knead.apply ghee on top and close lid and rest for 1 hour.
Take a ball and roll it in puri size and apply oil/ghee on top and foldas shown in pic and again apply oil (this is done to make layers)
Fold it on others sides and roll square and again apply oil/ghee and fold the 4 corners to between.
Roll into square shape and fry in oil. when one side puffs up flip to the other side till golden.
Drain out and enjy with chicken/mutton curry or with any paneer veg curry of your choice.
Note:Totally can take aata or maida. Can skip egg if want crispy pathiri.
